chunks: Muhammad ibn Umar al-Hafith al-Baghdadi narrated to us. He said: Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Abbas al-Razi narrated to me. He said: My father Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Abbas ibn Harun al-Tamimi narrated to me. He said: My master Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (as) narrated to me. He said: My father Musa ibn Ja'far narrated to me. He said: My father Ja'far ibn Muhammad narrated to me. He said: My father Muhammad ibn Ali narrated to me. He said: My father Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated to me. He said: My father al-Husayn ibn Ali narrated to me. He said: My brother al-Hasan ibn Ali narrated to me. He said: My father Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all) narrated to me. He said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to me:
You are the best of people, and no one will have doubt regarding you except a disbeliever.

key_terms.سلسلة الذهب: The golden chain -- unbroken narration through all the Imams

ai.seo_question: What is the golden chain hadith about Ali being the best of people?
ai.summary: This hadith features the famous 'golden chain' (silsilat al-dhahab) narration, transmitted through each of the twelve Imams from Imam al-Rida (as) back through Musa ibn Ja'far, Ja'far ibn Muhammad, Muhammad ibn Ali, Ali ibn al-Husayn, al-Husayn ibn Ali, al-Hasan ibn Ali, and finally Ali ibn Abi Talib (as). The Prophet (s) told Ali directly: 'You are the best of people, and no one doubts regarding you except a disbeliever.' The unbroken chain through the Imams makes this one of the most authoritative versions of this declaration.
